scope: Bounded raw/native follow-up of all remaining 94 pending V2 records in 37 extension02 MAIN100 exposures. All 242 previously raw-reviewed new V2 events remain unchanged.

selection_rule.priority: All remaining 37 unique MAIN100 exposures containing current_code N records in the frozen current336 table, matched exactly against the entire frozen continuation queue. No ranking by strength, wavelength, target, morphology or availability.
selection_rule.events: Review every accepted V2 event in selected exposures; every record must be pending N. No deduplication or replacement. All selected exposures must have no accepted V1 event.
selection_rule.input_requirement: Final production accounts for all100 spectra; selected merged input SHA256, provenance and metadata must match.

acquisition_bounds.rule: Validate metadata, unambiguous product identity, parent archive exposure, remote advertised sizes and candidate source hashes before preparing download jobs. If selected set cannot fit payload cap, keep selected exposures fixed; acquire only complete raw+ancillary pairs fitting in selected order, record omitted pairs and reason. Never replace unavailable/oversized selections with later exposures. Attempt bytes including retries count against cap; partial files cannot be used.
acquisition_bounds.transport: No redirects. HTTP401/403 are terminal for a product and not retried; no alternate host,path,credential or proxy fallback. Retry at most once for other errors within conservative byte cap.

publication_gate: Prepare selection/provenance/jobs locally after final production; stop before all raw or ancillary downloads until root has reviewed and verified prospective plan/code/selection publication. No local self-approval marker substitutes for root instruction.

native_review.baseline: Byte-identical batch03 native extraction, mapping-quality, global-registration and local-registration methods. Retain original descriptive local flags and require global plus five-window support for every covering order.
native_review.wavelength: Classical inverseBERV to topocentric air for mapping; all overlapping native orders; raw DATE-OBS and archiveID checks.
native_review.reference: Existing 24-region6-order global reference must pass. Five-window per-order quality is applied prospectively to every covering order without coordinate or orientation adjustment. Event mapping is supported only if global reference and every covering-order five-window gate and full-cutout availability pass.
native_review.raw_cutouts: Fixed31x33 raw cutouts with background median from first10/last10 dispersion rows; preserve original21x25 central cutout using wider[5:26,4:29], recompute its original first5/last5 background, retain41-point native snippets.
native_review.fiber_context: Record raw/native fiberB mode and TAR product membership; Bpresence does not imply sky.
native_review.wider_followup: Five-window mapping is prospective for all selected events in this batch; historical earlier-batch mapping methods are retained and not overwritten.
native_review.interpretation: Descriptive provisional morphology only; no automatic extraterrestrial/particle/atmospheric origin assignment; preserve original production catalogs and dispositions.

write_boundary: Only new v2/extension02/raw_followup_batch04/ until reviewed results are deliberately reconciled by root into current status files.

queue_snapshot.reason: Freeze copies before updating live current status; source hashes must match live sources during preparation.

cache_check: CACHE_CHECK.json compares all selected archive IDs against the 112 canonical products from the previous 56 exposure pairs and retained local filenames. Reuse is allowed only for exact original identities and verified hashes; noncanonical partial files are not inputs.
